name: Asuka
source:
A girl that was born and raised in a wealthy rural family.  She loves earrings with a feather-like design. She does compensated dating under the alias "Hime", and seems to be saving up money for a certain goal...

[Translated from [url=https://enoshima210.work/2022/07/08/kagotori/]Official Site[/url]]
